No step card, no fact. Sam holds no role yet, and the turn runs under the business his company names (default 130; K-05 v1.11 item 52). A bundle that holds S1-04 holds no door or any-time step here (default 129), so the three choices are the whole frontier. The text is the master's own answer (line 98) without its bare '1', since the question as asked today carries no numbered options (the design ruling's cards 20 and 21). The bundle id is the stand-in every K-09 fixture carries.
